user.title: Connect to Smart Frame Engine
user.description: Enter the address of your Smart Frame Engine, or paste its web address exactly as you open it in a browser. The API port is 8080 unless you changed it, or 443 behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the machine running Smart Frame Engine. The full web address of the engine also works.
data_description.port: Port of the Smart Frame Engine web server (443 for a typical HTTPS address).
data_description.ssl: Turn on if the engine is reached over HTTPS, for example behind a reverse proxy. A web address that starts with the secure scheme turns it on by itself.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only if the engine uses a self-signed certificate.

auth.title: Authentication required
auth.description: This Smart Frame Engine requires an API key. You can find it in the engine's web interface.

data_description.api_key: API key of the engine, sent as the X-API-Key header.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}?
zeroconf_confirm.description: Smart Frame Engine **{name}** was found at {host}:{port}. Do you want to add it to Home Assistant? If the engine requires an API key, enter it below.

data_description.api_key: API key of the engine. Leave empty only if the engine does not require authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for **{name}** was rejected. Enter the current API key.

data_description.api_key: The current API key of the engine.

error.invalid_host: Enter a host name, an IP address or a web address
error.ssl_error: The secure connection failed: the certificate could not be verified. Check the address, or turn off certificate verification for a self-signed certificate.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.integration_outdated: This Smart Frame Engine is newer than this integration supports. Update the Smart Frame Engine integration (HACS) and try again.
abort.server_outdated: This Smart Frame Engine is too old for this integration. Update the engine and try again.
abort.instance_id_missing: This Smart Frame Engine does not report an instance ID. Update the engine to version 1.0.0-rc.2 or later and try again.
abort.wrong_instance: The device at this address is a different Smart Frame Engine than the one configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks the engine for its status (10 to 3600 seconds).

set_ambient_context.name: Set ambient context
set_ambient_context.description: Tells the engine about the current situation (weather, who is home, season, boosts). Each field expires on its own. Fields you leave out keep their value; an empty text or list clears that field.

config_entry_id.name: Engine
config_entry_id.description: The Smart Frame Engine to use. Optional when only one is set up.

family_mode.name: Family Mode
family_mode.description: Temporarily forces Family Mode on or off.

presence.name: People at home
presence.description: Immich people at home; their photos are favoured (up to 20).

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: A weather keyword known to the engine, for example rainy (up to 80 characters).

boost_tags.name: Boost tags
boost_tags.description: Search phrases to favour, for example beach or birthday (up to 20).

ttl_minutes.name: Lifetime
ttl_minutes.description: How long the fields set by this call last, in minutes (1 to 10080). The engine's default applies when left empty.

clear_ambient_context.name: Clear ambient context
clear_ambient_context.description: Clears the ambient context, or only one field of it.

config_entry_id.name: Engine
config_entry_id.description: The Smart Frame Engine to use. Optional when only one is set up.

field.name: Field
field.description: Clear only this field. Leave empty to clear everything.

send_title_card.name: Send title card
send_title_card.description: Shows a text card (title, subtitle, caption) on the frame.

config_entry_id.name: Engine
config_entry_id.description: The Smart Frame Engine to use. Optional when only one is set up.

subtitle.name: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Smaller text below the title (up to 200 characters).

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Small text at the bottom (up to 200 characters).

accent.name: Accent color
accent.description: Color of the rule under the title.

ephemeral.name: Temporary
ephemeral.description: When on, the previous image comes back afterwards.

ttl_minutes.name: Duration
ttl_minutes.description: Temporary cards only: minutes before the previous image returns (1 to 10080). The engine's default (60) applies when left empty.

hold_minutes.name: Protect from refresh
hold_minutes.description: Minutes during which scheduled refreshes will not replace the card (1 to 10080).

push_to_fraimic.name: Send to frame
push_to_fraimic.description: Turn off to only render a preview without sending it to the frame.

show_now_playing.name: Show album cover
show_now_playing.description: Shows the cover of the track that is playing, with the artist and album. Pick a media player to fill the fields from it; values you set yourself win. The cover sent by Home Assistant is tried first; without a usable one the engine looks a cover up itself.

config_entry_id.name: Engine
config_entry_id.description: The Smart Frame Engine to use. Optional when only one is set up.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Fills the artist, album, title, position and cover from this player.

use_media_player_picture.name: Send the player's cover
use_media_player_picture.description: Send the cover of the media player to the engine (on by default). Turn off to let the engine look the cover up itself.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: Artist of the track (1 to 300 characters).

album.name: Album
album.description: Album of the track (up to 300 characters).

title.name: Track title
title.description: Title of the track (up to 300 characters).

artwork_url.name: Cover URL
artwork_url.description: Address of the cover. It must be reachable by the engine.

duration_seconds.name: Track length
duration_seconds.description: Length of the track, in seconds.

enrich_artwork.name: Look up a cover
enrich_artwork.description: When no usable cover is given, let the engine look one up (on by default).

ephemeral.name: Temporary
ephemeral.description: When on, the previous image comes back afterwards.

hold_minutes.name: Protect from refresh
hold_minutes.description: Minutes during which scheduled refreshes will not replace the cover (1 to 10080).

push_to_fraimic.name: Send to frame
push_to_fraimic.description: Turn off to only render a preview without sending it to the frame.

show_title.name: Print the track title
show_title.description: Print the track title on the cover. Without it, the frame is only refreshed when the album changes.

style.name: Style
style.description: Show the cover as a sleeve or as a vinyl record.

ttl_seconds.name: Duration
ttl_seconds.description: Seconds before the previous image returns (10 to 86400). Overrides the duration worked out from the track length.

show_media_poster.name: Show movie or series poster
show_media_poster.description: Finds a movie or series on TMDB and shows its poster. Pick a media player to fill the fields from it; values you set yourself win. The player's picture is only used when TMDB has no match.

config_entry_id.name: Engine
config_entry_id.description: The Smart Frame Engine to use. Optional when only one is set up.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Fills the title, type, season and fallback picture from this player.

use_media_player_picture.name: Use the player's picture as fallback
use_media_player_picture.description: Send the picture of the media player, shown when TMDB finds no poster (on by default).

query.name: Title
query.description: Title of the movie or series (1 to 200 characters).

media_type.name: Type
media_type.description: Look for a movie, a series, or both.

season.name: Season
season.description: Series only: prefer the poster of this season.

year.name: Year
year.description: Release year, to tell apart titles with the same name.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the poster, for example fr or fr-CA. The engine's language applies when left empty.

fallback_url.name: Fallback picture URL
fallback_url.description: Picture shown when TMDB has no match. It must be reachable by the engine.

ephemeral.name: Temporary
ephemeral.description: When on, the previous image comes back afterwards.

ttl_minutes.name: Duration
ttl_minutes.description: Temporary posters only: minutes before the previous image returns (1 to 1440). The engine's default applies when left empty.

hold_minutes.name: Protect from refresh
hold_minutes.description: Minutes during which scheduled refreshes will not replace the poster (1 to 10080).

push_to_fraimic.name: Send to frame
push_to_fraimic.description: Turn off to only render a preview without sending it to the frame.

integration_outdated.title: Smart Frame Engine integration needs an update
integration_outdated.description:
The engine **{name}** (version {server_version}) speaks API versions {min_api_version} to {api_version}, but this integration only supports version {supported_version}. The engine is newer than the integration.

Update the Smart Frame Engine integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant. This issue disappears on its own once the versions are compatible.

server_outdated.title: Smart Frame Engine needs an update
server_outdated.description:
The engine **{name}** (version {server_version}) speaks API versions {min_api_version} to {api_version}, but this integration needs version {supported_version}. The engine is older than the integration.

Update Smart Frame Engine. This issue disappears on its own once the versions are compatible.

invalid_auth.message: The Smart Frame Engine rejected the API key.

update_failed.message: Error communicating with the Smart Frame Engine: {error}

incompatible_server.message: The Smart Frame Engine is too old: it speaks API versions {min_api_version} to {api_version} but this integration needs version {supported_version}. Update the engine.

incompatible_integration.message: The Smart Frame Engine is newer than this integration: it speaks API versions {min_api_version} to {api_version} but this integration only supports version {supported_version}. Update the integration.

instance_mismatch.message: The device at the configured address is not {name}. It is a different Smart Frame Engine.

action_failed.message: The Smart Frame Engine could not do that: {error}

request_rejected.message: The Smart Frame Engine rejected the request: {error}

capability_not_supported.message: The Smart Frame Engine {name} does not support this feature ({capability}). Update the engine to use it.

no_context_fields.message: Give at least one ambient context field to set (family mode, presence, weather, season, boost tags or boost people).

config_entry_required.message: Several Smart Frame Engines are set up. Choose which one to use.

entry_not_found.message: No Smart Frame Engine with the ID {entry_id} was found.

no_engine_loaded.message: The Smart Frame Engine is not loaded. Check that it is reachable and try again.

missing_artist.message: No artist to show. Give an artist, or a media player that reports one.

missing_query.message: No title to look up. Give a title, or a media player that reports one.

media_player_not_found.message: The media player {entity_id} was not found.
